## Summary
What problem does this solve? Link a related issue only if one actually exists.

## Changes
- Describe the focused code or documentation changes.

## Testing
List commands you actually ran and their results, including failures or limitations.
For calculator changes, run `python calculator.py` and `python -m unittest -v`.

## Checklist
- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Changes are focused and understandable.
- [ ] I ran relevant tests and reported actual results above.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior, where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation matches the final files and commands.
- [ ] I inspected the diff and included no credentials or unrelated files.
